preconditions.description: The length of the input string s is between 5 and 10,000 characters.

postconditions.description: The output integer k is the number of distinct possible suffixes.

postconditions.expression: all(suffix in possible_suffixes for suffix in output_suffixes)
postconditions.description: Each suffix in the output is one of the possible suffixes of the input string s.
The output suffixes are sorted in lexicographical order.

postconditions.expression: not any(suffix in output_suffixes for suffix in output_suffixes[1:])
postconditions.description: There are no duplicate suffixes in the output.
